queries.sql: WITH SitePeak AS ( SELECT TOP 1 pa.Interval, AVG(CAST(pa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)) AS SiteAvgAQI FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND pa.Interval >= DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AND pa.Interval < DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval ORDER BY SiteAvgAQI DESC ) SELECT d.DeviceName, ROUND(CAST(pa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT), 1) AS AQI, sp.Interval AS PeakDateTime, ROUND(sp.SiteAvgAQI, 1) AS SiteAQI FROM SitePeak sp JOIN ParameterAverages pa ON pa.Interval = sp.Interval JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND pa.Status = 1 ORDER BY pa.Parametervalue DESC

queries.description: Compare the two devices at a specific site for a given month — shows each device's monthly average AQI and Data Success Rate. Use when user asks to compare devices at a school or site for a specific month/year.
patterns: how do the two devices at
queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(dc.Id), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN DeviceCompliance dc ON dc.DeviceId = d.DeviceId AND MONTH(dc.RecordedDate) = @month AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = @year WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND MONTH(pam.Interval) = @month AND YEAR(pam.Interval) = @year GROUP BY d.DeviceName ORDER BY d.DeviceName

Use when the user asks for the data success rate, data availability, compliance percentage, or how well devices are reporting.

queries.description: Device uptime/compliance rate for a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, d.DeviceName, COUNT(*) as ActiveDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, @startDate, @endDate) + 1 as TotalDays, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (DATEDIFF(DAY, @startDate, @endDate) + 1) * 100 as CompliancePct FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.StationID = @stationId AND dc.RecordedDate BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND dc.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, d.DeviceName ORDER BY CompliancePct DESC

queries.sql: SELECT TOP (@topN) d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(dc.Id), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE MONTH(dc.RecordedDate) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())) AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())) GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName ORDER BY DSR_Pct ASC

queries.description: Find which device(s) have been without data for the longest time — ranked by how long since their last reading. Use when user asks which device has been silent the longest, without data the longest, offline the longest, or hasn't sent data in the most time.

queries.sql: SELECT TOP (@topN) d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastReading, DATEDIFF(DAY, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime), GETDATE()) AS DaysSinceLastReading FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (@regionName IS NULL OR REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName), ' ', '') = REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName), ' ', '')) AND (@sectorName IS NULL OR LOWER(sec.SectorName) LIKE '%' + LOWER(@sectorName) + '%') AND (@stationName IS NULL OR LOWER(s.StationName) LIKE '%' + LOWER(@stationName) + '%') GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName HAVING MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) < DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) ORDER BY LastReading ASC

If a site name is mentioned, use devices_by_filter instead. NOTE: This count reflects all non-deleted devices system-wide and may differ slightly from the Device Overview page, which only shows devices belonging to the user's permitted stations.

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalDeviceCount FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0

queries.description: Count how many devices are currently active versus total registered devices for the user's permitted sites. Matches Executive Dashboard logic: a device is active if its last PM2.5 reading (DriverID=4) is within 1440 minutes OR LastCommunicationTime is within 10 minutes. Use only for HOW MANY / COUNT questions, NOT for listing which devices are online. Respects site/region filter from user's scope.
patterns: how many devices are currently active
queries.sql: WITH DriverPref AS ( SELECT DeviceID, ParameterReadingUpdateTime, LastCommunicationTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeviceID ORDER BY CASE WHEN ParameterName = 'PM2.5' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ParameterReadingUpdateTime DESC, ID DESC) AS rn FROM DMN_Parameters WHERE ParameterReadingUpdateTime IS NOT NULL ), LatestPM25 AS ( SELECT DeviceID, ParameterReadingUpdateTime, LastCommunicationTime FROM DriverPref WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT ISNULL(SUM(IsActive), 0) AS ActiveDeviceCount, COUNT(*) AS TotalDeviceCount FROM (SELECT d.DeviceId, CASE WHEN (MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR MAX(lp.LastCommunicationTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsActive FROM DMN_Devices d LEFT JOIN LatestPM25 lp ON lp.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY d.DeviceId) AS t

queries.description: COUNT the number of devices — optionally filtered by REGION (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra) and/or SECTOR and/or active/inactive status. Use for HOW MANY / TOTAL / COUNT questions about devices with any region, sector, or status filter. Examples: 'how many devices in Abu Dhabi', 'total devices in commercial sector', 'how many active devices in Al Ain', 'total number of devices under Abudhabi region'. NEVER use when user wants to SEE or LIST device names — use devices_by_filter instead.

queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, COUNT(*) AS TotalDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN live.LastReading >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR live.LastComm >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActiveDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN (live.LastReading < DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR live.LastReading IS NULL) AND (live.LastComm < DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now) OR live.LastComm IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InactiveDevices FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.DeviceID, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastReading, MAX(p.LastCommunicationTime) AS LastComm FROM DMN_Parameters p WHERE p.ParameterName = 'PM2.5' GROUP BY p.DeviceID) live ON live.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (@regionName IS NULL OR REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName),' ','') = REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName),' ','')) AND (@sectorName IS NULL OR LOWER(sec.SectorName) = LOWER(@sectorName)) GROUP BY r.RegionName, sec.SectorName ORDER BY r.RegionName, sec.SectorName

queries.description: List all currently offline/inactive devices system-wide. A device is offline when its last reading is older than 1440 minutes (24 hours). Use when the user asks which devices are offline, inactive, not sending, not connected, or not transmitting — with no site/region/sector filter.
patterns: are there any devices that are not connected
queries.sql: WITH DriverPref AS ( SELECT DeviceID, ParameterReadingUpdateTime, LastCommunicationTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeviceID ORDER BY CASE WHEN ParameterName = 'PM2.5' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ParameterReadingUpdateTime DESC, ID DESC) AS rn FROM DMN_Parameters WHERE ParameterReadingUpdateTime IS NOT NULL ), LatestPM25 AS ( SELECT DeviceID, ParameterReadingUpdateTime, LastCommunicationTime FROM DriverPref WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastActive FROM DMN_Devices d LEFT JOIN LatestPM25 lp ON lp.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName HAVING (MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) IS NULL OR MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) < DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now)) AND (MAX(lp.LastCommunicationTime) IS NULL OR MAX(lp.LastCommunicationTime) < DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now)) ORDER BY r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, s.StationName, d.DeviceName

queries.description: THE SINGLE template for ALL device listing and counting questions. Filters by any combination of: SITE name (stationName), REGION (regionName), SECTOR (sectorName), STATUS (statusFilter). Covers: 'devices at X site', 'devices under X school', 'offline devices in Abu Dhabi', 'active devices in commercial sector', 'which devices are inactive', 'how many devices are offline', 'devices available at X'. NEVER use when user asks about a SPECIFIC named device (BA/SEI100M code) — use device_status or device_live_reading instead.

queries.sql: WITH DriverPref AS ( SELECT DeviceID, ParameterReadingUpdateTime, LastCommunicationTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeviceID ORDER BY CASE WHEN ParameterName = 'PM2.5' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ParameterReadingUpdateTime DESC, ID DESC) AS rn FROM DMN_Parameters WHERE ParameterReadingUpdateTime IS NOT NULL ), LatestPM25 AS ( SELECT DeviceID, ParameterReadingUpdateTime, LastCommunicationTime FROM DriverPref WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName AS SubSectorName, CASE WHEN MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR MAX(lp.LastCommunicationTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status, MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastActive, MAX(CASE WHEN pa.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' THEN pa.ParameterValue END) AS AQI FROM DMN_Devices d LEFT JOIN LatestPM25 lp ON lp.DeviceID = d.DeviceId LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters pa ON pa.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors ss ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (@regionName IS NULL OR REPLACE(LOWER(r.RegionName),' ','') = REPLACE(LOWER(@regionName),' ','')) AND (@sectorName IS NULL OR LOWER(sec.SectorName) = LOWER(@sectorName)) AND (@stationName IS NULL OR LOWER(s.StationName) LIKE '%' + LOWER(@stationName) + '%') GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName HAVING 1=1 AND (@statusFilter IS NULL OR CASE WHEN MAX(lp.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR MAX(lp.LastCommunicationTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END = @statusFilter) ORDER BY r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, s.StationName, d.DeviceName

queries.description: Check whether a SPECIFIC named device (e.g. SEI100M 0009, BA 0003) is currently active or inactive, or when it last sent data. Active = LastCommunicationTime within 1440 minutes (24 hours). Inactive = no communication in 24 hours. ALWAYS use this when user names a specific device and asks about its status, whether it is online/offline/working, or when it last sent/reported/measured data. NEVER use offline_devices for single device status questions.
patterns: can you tell me whether device is active
can you tell me whether device is

queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 d.DeviceName, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastMeasured, MAX(p.LastCommunicationTime) AS LastCommunication, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR MAX(p.LastCommunicationTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = @paddedCanonical) GROUP BY d.DeviceName ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DeviceName = @deviceName THEN 0 WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, d.DeviceName

queries.description: Get metadata for a specific device by device name: site name, region, sector, sub-sector, device model, deployed/created date, last measured time, current status, and list of monitored pollutants. Use when user asks about device details, site of a device, region of a device, sector of a device, when a device was deployed/created/installed, what pollutants a device monitors, or any metadata question about a specific device (not live readings).
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName AS SubSectorName, d.DeviceModel, d.CreatedOn AS DeployedOn, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastMeasured, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -1440, @now) OR MAX(p.LastCommunicationTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @now) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors ss ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id LEFT JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = @paddedCanonical) GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, ss.SectorName, d.DeviceModel, d.CreatedOn ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DeviceName = @deviceName THEN 0 WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, d.DeviceName

queries.description: List the parameters/pollutants monitored by a specific device. Use when the user asks what a device measures, what pollutants it monitors, or which parameters it has.
queries.sql: SELECT p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(UPPER(@deviceName),' ','') OR REPLACE(UPPER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = @paddedCanonical) ORDER BY p.ParameterName

queries.description: Get historical readings for a specific device at a chosen time interval. Intervals: '5min' or 'live' → ParameterReadings (5-minute raw data), '1hour' or '1H' → ParameterAverages Type=1, '8hour' or '8H' → ParameterAverages Type=8, '24hour' or '24H' or 'daily' → ParameterAverages Type=24, 'monthly' or '1month' → ParameterAveragesMonth, 'yearly' or 'annual' → ParameterAveragesYear. Use when user mentions a device name AND a time interval or time period. For LIVE/CURRENT readings with no time specification, use device_live_reading instead.
